What a day yesterday — Portugal put on a clinic with a 5-0 demolition of Uzbekistan, Norway edged Senegal in a 3-2 thriller, and Croatia squeezed past Panama 1-0 to keep their knockout hopes alive. England and Ghana played out a tense 0-0 draw that leaves Group L wide open heading into the final matchday.

Today's slate is packed with drama: Colombia already grabbed a 1-0 win over DR Congo to stay perfect in Group K, and now we've got decisive Group B and Group C action on the way. Switzerland vs. Canada is a battle for the top spot in Group B, while Scotland vs. Brazil and Morocco vs. Haiti could shake up one of the tightest groups in the tournament.
